_comment: Tier-2 for febio::hyperelasticity#0. A Mooney-Rivlin material without <k> gives 'K must be a positive number.' and exit 1; the same material with <k> runs to normal termination; and the shipped coupled neo-Hookean, which has no <k> parameter at all, also runs. All three are required, because the claim is the DISTINCTION between coupled and uncoupled materials, not the message alone. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
